subject: ddl: Non clustered reorg duplicate  tidb rowid fix (#60132)
summary: Reviewed table-layer changes vs first parent: introduces `AddRecordOpt.GenerateRecordID()` to control whether `AddRecord` consumes an explicit `_tidb_rowid`, adds `UpdateRecordOpt.GetAddRecordOptKeepRecordID()` for reorg-partition update paths, and updates partitioned-table `UpdateRecord`/`RemoveRecord` logic to preserve `_tidb_rowid` across reorganize partition double-write where possible while avoiding incorrect deletes/inserts via txn lookups and row-value equality checks. Also adjusts per-partition index state selection during DeleteReorganization/Public to keep index writes consistent across adding/dropping definition partitions. No remaining Blocker/High issues found; later history up to `upstream/master` shows no follow-up fix specifically targeting this change set.
